value.rationale: Reflection complexity is a motivated invariant introduced in 2024. An exact all-base census for geometric-support automatic words is a natural infinite-family classification; the base-two formula is exceptionally simple, while bases >=3 display quantified nonconvergent normalized complexity with a full accumulation interval. No arbitrary parameter slice or mere literature reformulation is involved.
